## Current stress disposition — 11 September 2026

Part of the private-launch proof under #216/#268. **The native caller migration is merged in PR #305; full stress diagnosis can resume.** The migrated 1,001-Product publication/export case now exposes a separate 120-second test-deadline failure; its later restore/export assertions remain unverified. [Exact reproduction and evidence](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/issues/253#issuecomment-5628853432). Routine validation #271 and tooling #272 are complete; their old failures do not block resumption.

Main `75c0ae5c962b6d908c1492a44e83d0ab3e36f491` (PR #305), schema 32: [resulting-main CI 34560474989](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34560474989) passes all nine required jobs. Routine validation is green; extended journeys, full stress, accepted-tier capacity and live rollout remain separate evidence gates.

## Completed and historical evidence

- [x] Correct the stress entrypoint so expected ingestion files run and missing expected tests still fail.
- [x] Correct host-pacing diagnostics to use retained request identities and retain the independent-host assertions.
- [x] Obtain a bounded manual workflow pass: [34416176363](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34416176363), two tests in two files on `1894113c`. This predates the final tooling changes and is not a current-main/full-capacity pass.

The last complete full run retained in this ticket is [34336061374](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34336061374): 16 passed / 3 failed. The two legacy reconciliation failures and the native 1,001-Product 15,000 ms elapsed-budget failure are preserved in the comments. Historical hosted timings are not measurements of today's code.

## Next work and remaining acceptance

- [ ] Using the native callers merged in #305, inventory and run the intended full current selection through `pnpm run test:stress:full`; current main contains ten stress files, including native 128-image coverage. Correct the stale nine-file runbook description.
- [ ] Diagnose the migrated 1,001-Product publication/export case that exceeds its unchanged 120-second test deadline. Preserve every behavioral assertion and obtain a completed restore/export result. Keep this separate from the existing candidate performance assertion below.
- [ ] Remeasure the native 1,001-Product result on the current runtime and diagnose any failure. Keep the existing 15,000 ms performance assertion distinct from test-harness deadlines and from CPU/billing claims; do not inflate it to mask the historical failure.
- [ ] Record every complete-run failure and its disposition. Coordinate usable capacity with #275 and uncovered durable faults with #276 without duplicating ownership.
- [ ] Obtain successful full manual workflow execution (`suite: full`) on the final code/runtime, plus current bounded scheduled/manual verification. A green default bounded run does not replace full stress.

The default weekly workflow runs two bounded pacing/throughput checks; full capacity experiments are explicit and separate. Their pass still does not certify the 5/50 GiB tiers, since the tier-admission probe fetches zero bodies. Keep this issue open until its remaining full-selection acceptance is met.

Use [the current testing policy](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146/docs/testing.md) and [stress operations](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146/docs/runbooks/scheduled-stress.md). Run heavy tests with exclusive measurement resources and retain exact SHAs. This reconciliation starts no workflow, capacity campaign or live operation. The issue title is unchanged because automated failure reporting finds this exact title.

<details>
<summary>Original scope and earlier checkpoint — historical; use the current acceptance above</summary>

## Implementation checkpoint — 9 September 2026
The entrypoint and API-coverage disposition are implemented in https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/pull/277 (draft; merge pending). The package command now selects the existing ingestion stress suites directly and preserves missing-test failures.

Focused execution reaches `runtime-host-pacing.stress.spec.ts`, but line 43 fails: timestamp subtraction is `NaN`, expected at least 500 ms. The test expects request IDs `first-a`, `second-a`, `first-b`, and `second-b`; establish why their diagnostics are unavailable before drawing a production pacing conclusion. The complete stress selection and green scheduled/manual Actions run remain outstanding. Keep this issue open.

## Diagnosis — 9 September 2026
At main 51e1c83f, `npm run test:stress` first selects `apps/api/test/**/*.stress.spec.ts`; there are no such files. Vitest exits 1 with “No test files found,” so `&&` prevents all existing ingestion stress suites from running. This reproduced locally and matches the scheduled failure below.

## Acceptance
- [x] Explicitly run the intended stress suites and retain failure propagation when expected tests are absent.
- [x] Reconcile API performance coverage with current scope; avoid a blanket pass-with-no-tests setting.
- [ ] Run the intended suite to completion on the final code/runtime and record every remaining regression. Coordinate capacity/fault failures with #268 and suite reliability with #271 without duplicating evidence.
- [ ] Obtain a green scheduled or manually dispatched stress run before closing. A fixed entrypoint or one passing file alone is not full stress success.

## Original scheduled evidence
The `stress` workflow failed.

- Run: https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34100293889
- Trigger: `schedule`
- Commit: `cf6967fb7e1bc8fc407fc4eaff1c08c4538e00e4`

Inspect the run log, fix or file the regression, then close this issue. See `docs/runbooks/scheduled-stress.md`.

</details>

PR #278 now contains reviewed stress-identity correction `45e47ea2` (included in implementation0942e096 and evidence head12f996bc), stacked on #272/#270 providers. The original runtime reproduction reported `NaN >= 500` because fixture labels no longer matched retained request identities. Resolving through Source Snapshot URL and fetch-attempt ID retains the actual per-host spacing and independent-host concurrency assertions; missing/invalid retained timestamps fail explicitly. Original red4.08s → focused green3.66s, typecheck pass.

This reuses PR #277’s corrected stress entrypoint; it does not complete #253. Full current-runtime stress selection and a green scheduled or manually dispatched workflow remain pending required provider/reliability/publication integration. No skipped selection or focused pass is substituted for complete verification.

The `stress` workflow failed.

- Run: https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34336061374
- Trigger: `workflow_dispatch`
- Commit: `b28d2afc7dd4d37bfcb7a3c59ac62be5500bdcba`

Inspect the run log, fix or file the regression, then close this issue. See `docs/runbooks/scheduled-stress.md`.

Preliminary **complete manual stress** run on combined foundation `b28d2afc7dd4d37bfcb7a3c59ac62be5500bdcba` finished naturally with failure: [34336061374](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34336061374), 16 passed / 3 failed across all 19 tests and 9 files in558.12s. No cancellation, skipped selection or local host overlap.

The corrected host-pacing test passed on the hosted Node22/current Cloudflare runtime. Remaining failures are concrete:

1. `game-reconciliation-scale.stress.spec.ts`:1001-Product native candidate callback journey took50,118ms against its existing15,000ms performance assertion. The callback budget observations remain retained; the elapsed bound has not been raised.
2. `reconciliation-scale.stress.spec.ts`:1001-entity legacy reconciliation did not complete its existing helper bound.
3. Same file: Product-heavy legacy reconciliation did not complete that bound.

The last two still exercise the aggregate approval caller family being retired by #274, so final stress must migrate their setup/assertions through the real native owner protocol and re-run after that provider is integrated. Native elapsed-time failure requires diagnosis; it is not treated as a timeout-allocation issue. Raw hosted log is retained at `/tmp/card-keepr-launch-20260909/253-preliminary-stress.log` and the GitHub run.

This is diagnostic evidence, not acceptance completion. Final integrated full stress plus distinct scheduled/manual verification remain open.

## Isolated native Product stress comparison — 2026-09-09

The unchanged 1,001-Product native stress assertion remains **failed on hosted runners**. The 15,000ms budget has not been relaxed. Isolated measurements retain the existing callback reporter and original test; manual-only diagnostic branches have no PR and must not be merged.

| Exact revision / environment | Callback elapsed | Result |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `06dd8052e492c156ed2b8a2d88f601f5743b957d` — reviewed cleanup `a14a8034` application/test/lockfile, old runtime, isolated Ubuntu Node 22 | 49,107ms | Failed unchanged 15,000ms assertion; [run 34345172331](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34345172331) |
| `4cc3d13a` — reconciled runtime, isolated Ubuntu Node 22 | 68,249ms | Failed unchanged assertion; [run 34344497669](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34344497669) |
| `9e22a3409808b11d863072f9358916c0f22879a1` — local macOS arm64 Node 22, exclusive host lease | 11,714ms | Passed; 15.856s process duration, natural exit |

Every capture contains exactly 1,360 successful callbacks, zero failed callbacks, zero callbacks over 100 method entries, and 34,839 total method entries: D1.first 17,093; D1.batch 17,132; D1.all 551; EVIDENCE_OBJECTS.get 1; Workflow driver create/status 30 each, get/sendEvent 1 each. Counts represent method entries, not provider billing or CPU. Wall time is not CPU time.

This establishes that the hosted failure exists with the pre-upgrade toolchain and persists when this test is the only hosted workload. One sample per hosted toolchain does not separate runner variability from version-specific cost, and does not establish a 39% upgrade regression. Local success does not satisfy the hosted stress gate. Full stress, scheduled/manual verification and #253 completion remain pending required native caller/reliability fixes and a passing final stress gate.

Raw hosted logs and callback artifacts are retained by the linked runs and in `/tmp/card-keepr-launch-20260909/`; no diagnostic instrumentation or alternative workflow is being integrated as release evidence.

#274's remaining caller migration is implemented in PR #305 at `ed163d4f50a2641dd3f76da045a8865337b8932c` (base `e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146`; integration pending). All four formerly successful fresh run-approval callers now use the existing native candidate, inspection, artifact, whole-candidate approval, publication-status and actual SQL backup/restore helpers. The legacy helper is removed; explicit 410 and historical reservation/recovery coverage remains.

The affected stress file has a reproduced independent performance gap:

- `KEEPR_TEST_SUITE=stress pnpm exec vitest run --config apps/ingestion/vitest.config.ts apps/ingestion/test/reconciliation-scale.stress.spec.ts` completed with **3 passed / 1 failed** in 307.98 seconds. The 1,001-Card, 128 × 100 KiB image and warning-heavy cases pass.
- The 1,001-Product case exceeds its unchanged **120-second test deadline**. Isolated natural completion was 154.481 seconds (process 157.21); combined natural completion was 170.944 seconds. Both reach native switch and backup dispatch; later Product backup/export assertions remain unverified. No deadline, fixture, assertion or production guard was relaxed.
- The isolated trace records 11,964 artifact callbacks with 80.826 seconds summed callback wall time, and 4,270 export callbacks with 27.715 seconds. These are local callback entry timings, not a disjoint end-to-end breakdown, Worker CPU or provider billing.

This is distinct from the already tracked native candidate **15,000 ms performance assertion**. Resume full-selection diagnosis after integration and retain both gaps independently. This file-level result is not full stress or accepted-tier capacity certification. Measurements ran on macOS with Node 26.8.2, pnpm 12.3.4 and Vitest 4.1.11, without another heavy local runtime suite.

[Caller inventory, assertion translations and immutable raw evidence](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/ed163d4f50a2641dd3f76da045a8865337b8932c/docs/reviews/publication-caller-retirement-2026-09-11.md). The final Product component digest assertion was corrected after the combined run began; it was not reached in either timed-out run and is not claimed as verified. #275 retains capacity/accounting ownership; #274 remains open for the explicit acceptance/integration gaps.

The `stress` workflow failed.

- Trigger: `workflow_dispatch`
- Commit: `7956ae7641cce73a7e836d5760333dae8b348f96`
